beats.text: The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it.
